title: Ordinary higher direct image coproduct comparison is epic
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $I$ be a set, let $M_i$ and $N$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and suppose $\iota_i:M_i\to N$ is a coproduct cofan in that category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every $p\in\mathbb N$, let $R^p f_*$ denote ordinary right-derived module direct image [pqf-def-cohomology]. Then the canonical map $\bigoplus_i R^p f_*M_i\to R^p f_*N$ whose restrictions are $R^p f_*(\iota_i)$ is an epimorphism. No quasi-coherence assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 07TB, proof on inverse images of affine opens; Tags 01FF and 01FE

proof.text: Fix maps a,b out of R^p f_*N with equal composites with the coproduct comparison. Precompose by each coproduct injection; the Sigma.ι_desc identity gives R^p f_*(ι_i) followed by a equal to the same map followed by b.

Use the affine-local cohomology presentation to reduce a=b to equality after each natural comparison c_V(N) on every affine V in Y. Set U=f^{-1}(V). QuasiCompact f and the compactness of affine V make U compact; QuasiSeparated f and the quasi-separatedness of affine V make U quasi-separated (Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isCompact_preimage and isQuasiSeparated_preimage). Restriction along U.ι is left adjoint to pushforward, so isColimitOfPreserves transports the given coproduct cofan to U.toScheme.

Apply moduleCohomology_directSum_bijective to the restricted cofan on U.toScheme and use its surjectivity clause. Naturality of c_V and the equalities on each summand imply that c_V(N) followed by the section maps of a and b agree on the images of every summand cohomology group.

The private additive-group helper pulls back an arbitrary class through the surjective DirectSum.toModule map and performs DirectSum.induction_on. Agreement on each summand, zero and sums gives equality on every class. Apply the detection clause of the presentation to obtain a=b, which is the categorical definition of Epi. Empty index sets are covered by the same zero and addition induction; p=0 needs no special branch.

proof_origin.place: Affine-local cohomology argument; categorical right cancellation instead of constructing source germs
proof_origin.note: Restriction and cohomology-surjectivity steps and naturality/additive finite-support glue compiled in Lean. The coefficient-natural affine presentation is isolated as one strictly smaller statement.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleHigherDirectImage_coproduct_epi
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (I : Type u) (M : I → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ι : ∀ i, M i ⟶ N)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk N ι)) (p : ℕ) :
    Epi (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦
      ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).map (ι i)))
